about_the_game:
Star Trek Adventures - Second Edition - Starter Set


TO BOLDLY GO WHERE NO ONE HAS GONE BEFORE!


The

Star Trek(TM) Adventures roleplaying game takes you to the final frontier! You may travel to the edges of known space, to colonies in need, to the borders of neighboring galactic powers, or into the eye of interstellar phenomena. Explore strange new worlds, encounter fantastical alien life-forms, and engage in dramatic adventures in a detailed and immersive Galaxy.




PLAY STRAIGHT OUT OF THE BOX!


This

Starter Set contains everything you need to begin your journey into the final frontier, including an epic campaign of three linked missions designed to challenge a brave crew of 3-7 player characters.

The

Star Trek Adventures Second Edition Starter Set includes:

<ul> <li>
RULES BOOKLET: Adapted from the 48-page booklet providing an overview of the 2d20 game system adapted for

Star Trek Adventures , for use with the included campaign.</li>
<li>
CAMPAIGN BOOKLET: Adapted from the 60-page booklet containing the epic, three-part campaign "Infinite Combinations," which guides you through the rules as you play so you can begin exploring the Galaxy straight out of the box.</li>
<li>
PRE-GENERATED SHIP and CHARACTERS:  Ship record for the
Constitution -class
U.S.S. Challenger and seven pre-generated player character sheets, with rules references.</li>
<li>
REFERENCE SHEETS: Adapted versions of the 

Starter Set
 rules reference sheets.</li>
<li>
TOKENS:  Digital tokens for the 
U.S.S. Challenger, player characters, and each of six different civilizations.</li> </ul>"
